excluded.name: Young's Literal Translation
excluded.reason: eBible's USFM carries no title markup: psalm titles are fused into verse 1 with nothing to say where they end, so there is no oracle and the converter correctly refuses it. Needs a title source or a person-reviewed title table. See 17tnw2b2hkm.

excluded.name: Majority Standard Bible
excluded.reason: Same defect as YLT. BSB cannot serve as the oracle: the two Old Testaments differ in over a hundred verses, so aligning them would guess.

excluded.name: Open English Bible (US)
excluded.reason: Incomplete: 44 of the 66 canonical books (no 1-2 Samuel, 1-2 Kings or 1-2 Chronicles).
